values.note: $38 a night at nearly every site, all year, 2026 and 2027 alike; site 01 (pull-through, off the water) is $36. The two double sites (37 and 42) are $76.

fees.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/232735/rates ('Peak Season' 2026-01-01..2026-12-31 and 2027-01-01..2027-12-31: STANDARD ELECTRIC 38, RV ELECTRIC 38, double 76, one template 36); per-site price_range in https://www.recreation.gov/api/search/campsites?fq=asset_id%3A232735 (46 sites $38, site 01 $36, sites 37 and 42 $76), read 2026-10-29

hookups.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/232735 ('51 public campsites with full water/electric hookups'); https://www.recreation.gov/api/search/campsites?fq=asset_id%3A232735 ('Electricity Hookup' 50 and 'Water Hookup' Y at every site carrying the attributes; no sewer attribute), read 2026-10-29

values.note: 51 public sites plus 2 park-attendant sites; driveways 28-50 ft, so all take a 23-ft rig; 18 pull-throughs; 41 of the 49 bookable site records tagged lakefront. Sites 2-23 stay open in winter.

sites.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/232735 ('2 park attendant campsites, 51 public campsites'); https://www.recreation.gov/api/search/campsites?fq=asset_id%3A232735 ('Max Vehicle Length' 28-50, 'Driveway Entry' 18 pull-through, 'Proximity to Water' 41 Lakefront), read 2026-10-29

facilities.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/232735 ('3 comfort stations (2 with showers), 1 dump station, 1 boat ramp, 1 courtesy dock, 2 playgrounds'), read 2026-10-29

values.note: Open all year; December-March only sites 2-23 are open, the whole campground April-November.

season.source: https://www.sas.usace.army.mil/About/Divisions-and-Offices/Operations-Division/Hartwell-Dam-and-Lake/Plan-A-Visit/Camping/ ('WATSADLER Open Year-round!'); https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/availability/campground/232735/month (Dec 2026 - Mar 2027: sites 02-23 Available/Reserved, sites 24-51 'Closed'; Nov 2026 and Apr 2027: all sites open), read 2026-10-29

values.note: No minimum stay. 14 nights in any 30, and splitting names or sites to get round it is cancelled. Gate locked 10 pm - 7 am (check in before 10 pm); check-in 3 pm, check-out 2 pm; one camping unit and up to three vehicles per site.

booking.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/232735 (rules minConsecutiveStay 1, maxStay 14 nights 'Rolling 30 Days'; notices 'Entrance gate OPENS at 7 a.m. and LOCKS at 10 p.m.', 'Check in time is 3 p.m.; check out time is 2 p.m.', 'Maximum stay is 14-days within 30 day period', 'Up to 3 vehicles may be registered per site'), read 2026-10-29

discounts.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/232735 (notice: 'Golden Age/Access and America the Beautiful Interagency Senior and Access Passes are accepted at this campground and cardholders receive a 50% discount on camping fees'), read 2026-10-29

note: USACE Savannah District campground on Hartwell Lake near the dam, in pine and hardwood cover, with a boat ramp and courtesy dock. --Claude
